ashtakavarga.description: Ashtakavarga is a method of measuring benefic influence (bindus) that planets contribute to each sign. Source: BPHS Chapter 66

sun.name: Sun
sun.description: Sun's ashtakavarga calculation uses reference points from all 8 factors

moon.name: Moon
moon.description: Moon's ashtakavarga represents emotional and psychological benefic influences

mars.name: Mars
mars.description: Mars's ashtakavarga indicates courage, energy, and drive in various signs

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.description: Mercury's ashtakavarga represents intellect, communication, and analytical abilities

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.description: Jupiter's ashtakavarga indicates wisdom, prosperity, and spiritual development

venus.name: Venus
venus.description: Venus's ashtakavarga represents love, relationships, creativity, and material comfort

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.description: Saturn's ashtakavarga indicates discipline, longevity, and karmic lessons

sarvashtakavarga.description: Sarvashtakavarga (SAV) is the total of all planet bindus for each sign. Ranges from 0-56.

very_weak.meaning: Very weak influence; challenging period or house; requires careful planning and effort
very_weak.effects: Low benefic influence, obstacles, delays, need for extra effort

weak.meaning: Weak influence; some challenges but manageable with effort
weak.effects: Limited benefic influence, mixed results, need for strategic approach

moderate.meaning: Moderate influence; balanced period with both challenges and opportunities
moderate.effects: Reasonable benefic influence, balanced outcomes, normal progress

strong.meaning: Strong influence; favorable period with good opportunities
strong.effects: Good benefic influence, favorable outcomes, positive progression

very_strong.meaning: Very strong influence; highly auspicious period; excellent results expected
very_strong.effects: Excellent benefic influence, highly favorable outcomes, significant achievements

sarvashtakavarga.comment: Average SAV is 28. Values above 28 are above average; values below 28 are below average

kakshya_rules.description: Kakshya divisions provide sub-divisions within each sign for more detailed analysis
kakshya_rules.definition: Kakshya is a subdivision system that divides each house/sign into smaller segments based on planetary strengths

first_kakshya.strength_interpretation: First half of sign; earlier manifestation of energies

second_kakshya.strength_interpretation: Second half of sign; later manifestation of energies

strength_modification.rule: SAV strength is modified based on kakshya position and planetary placement within the kakshya
strength_modification.application: Use kakshya for precise timing of transits and sub-period analysis

transit_strength_interpretation.description: Rules for interpreting planetary strength during transits based on ashtakavarga
transit_strength_interpretation.general_rule: A transiting planet in a sign with high SAV tends to produce benefic results

high_sav_transit.result: Favorable period; planet produces predominantly positive effects
high_sav_transit.duration: Effects typically manifest throughout transit period

moderate_sav_transit.result: Mixed period; balanced outcomes with both challenges and opportunities

low_sav_transit.result: Challenging period; planet may produce adverse or minimal effects
low_sav_transit.duration: Requires careful planning and remedial measures

transiting_planet_strength.description: Each transiting planet also has its own ashtakavarga strength
transiting_planet_strength.consideration: Combine transit SAV with individual planet's ashtakavarga for comprehensive analysis

timing_indicators.exact_sade_sati: During Sade Sati, check Saturn's ashtakavarga in involved signs
timing_indicators.dhaiya_period: During Dhaiya, check Saturn's ashtakavarga in 4th and 8th from Moon
timing_indicators.mahadasha_analysis: Combine dasha period with ashtakavarga strength for period assessment

ashtakavarga_calculation_method.step_1: For each planet, calculate its ashtakavarga by counting benefic houses from 8 reference points
ashtakavarga_calculation_method.step_2: Reference points are: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, and Lagna
ashtakavarga_calculation_method.step_3: For each reference point, add 1 bindu for each sign where that planet's benefic houses fall
ashtakavarga_calculation_method.step_4: Sum all bindus (max 8 per sign since 8 reference points)
ashtakavarga_calculation_method.step_5: Create ashtakavarga chart showing bindu count for each sign for each planet
ashtakavarga_calculation_method.step_6: Calculate Sarvashtakavarga by summing all planet bindus for each sign (max 56)
ashtakavarga_calculation_method.step_7: Interpret using SAV ranges for predictive analysis

bindus_per_reference_point.description: Each of the 8 reference points contributes 0-1 bindu per sign based on benefic house rules

strong_signs_interpretation.definition: Signs with high SAV (45+) are considered strong/auspicious positions
strong_signs_interpretation.usage: Strong SAV signs indicate favorable timing for activities and natural support from universal energies
strong_signs_interpretation.weak_signs_interpretation: Signs with low SAV (0-12) require extra effort and careful planning

combined_ashtakavarga.definition: Combination of all individual planet ashtakavarga charts into single comprehensive chart
combined_ashtakavarga.benefit: Provides holistic view of overall strength and weakness across all signs
combined_ashtakavarga.application: Used for dasha timing, transit prediction, and muhurta selection

methodology_notes.ancient_text: Traditional Vedic astrology system based on Sanskrit original texts
methodology_notes.accuracy: Values based on classical interpretations of BPHS Chapter 66
methodology_notes.application_note: Use in conjunction with natal chart analysis, dasha periods, and transits for complete prediction
